subject.statement: Michael I. Jordan, the UC Berkeley machine-learning professor, played professional basketball in the NBA.

summary: The claim that UC Berkeley professor Michael I. Jordan played professional basketball in the NBA is false; his faculty profile shows no NBA involvement, and authoritative sports records contain no entry for a player with his exact name.

findings.statement: The UC Berkeley faculty profile for Michael I. Jordan describes his academic positions and does not mention any NBA professional basketball career.
NBA.com, Basketball-Reference.com, and ESPN list only Michael Jordan (without a middle initial) and contain no player record for Michael I. Jordan or Michael Irwin Jordan.
No UC Berkeley press releases or biographies located in the evidence mention Michael I. Jordan having any professional basketball experience.

gaps: The full name and date of birth of Michael I. Jordan as stated on his official UC Berkeley faculty profile or biography (Q5) were not provided in the evidence.
Any UC Berkeley press releases or biographies that mention Michael I. Jordan having professional basketball experience (Q6) were not found in the evidence.
Sports archives (NBA, FIBA) for a player named Michael Irwin Jordan (Q7) were not located in the evidence.
